description.value: Bliss Bakery is a long-established artisan bakery and bistro founded in 2005, known for slow-fermented sourdough breads made with a starter originally cultivated from Okanagan grapes. The West Kelowna location operates as a grab-and-go kitchen serving house-made croissants, hearty sandwiches, soups, and crafted organic coffee. A second lakeside location in Peachland offers views of Okanagan Lake.
